paths.description: Homepage and primary search entry, representing the core public task.
Services directory, representing the long listing/navigation template.
Representative search-results journey using query “web standards”; redirected to anti-bot challenge.

findings.summary: Automated search reaches a CAPTCHA instead of results
findings.evidence: A direct navigation to the search results URL redirected to “Please confirm that you are not a robot”; the cookie panel also overlaps the challenge in the captured viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide an accessible low-friction challenge and avoid covering it with consent UI; offer a documented machine-facing search path where appropriate.

findings.summary: The homepage and services directory omit the viewport meta tag
findings.evidence: At a requested 360x800 viewport, layout reported hasViewportMeta:false and a 980px/1020px layout viewport scaled to 0.367/0.353; screenshots show desktop UI rendered extremely small.
findings.suggestedFix: Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` and validate responsive breakpoints at narrow widths.

findings.summary: The search combobox is missing required ARIA state
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found `input#text[role=combobox]` lacks required `aria-expanded`; its accessibility score was 0.89.
findings.suggestedFix: Synchronize aria-expanded with suggestion popup state and ensure every icon control has an accessible name.

findings.summary: The Cookie Policy link relies on low-contrast color alone
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured only 1.26:1 contrast between the yellow link and surrounding text and found no non-color distinction.
findings.suggestedFix: Underline the link or add another persistent cue and raise link-to-surrounding-text contrast to at least 3:1.

findings.summary: An animation continues under reduced-motion preference
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion:reduce matched, getAnimations() still returned a running 3000ms animation with an unbounded iteration count.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential repeating animation in a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce query and retain only essential state changes.

findings.evidence: The trace and Lighthouse independently measured LCP at about 5.85s; Lighthouse performance was 0.76 and LCP score 0.15.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP element and shorten its critical path, prioritising the LCP resource and reducing document/server delay.

findings.summary: Tracking requests and persistent identifiers occur while consent is still being requested
findings.evidence: The screenshot shows the consent banner while HAR recorded 18 third-party requests (296,026 bytes), including mc.yandex.ru, and the cookie audit found 14 first-party cookies, many SameSite=None and up to 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential analytics and identifier storage until consent, minimise cookie lifetime/scope, and batch essential telemetry.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policy coverage is incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found CSP allows unsafe-eval and lacks Permissions-Policy; the CSP does otherwise use a nonce and HSTS/XFO/nosniff are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unsafe-eval by refactoring affected scripts and send a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Cookie consent uses custom controls without a semantic dialog
findings.evidence: DOM probing found no `<dialog>`, popover, or role=dialog; consent actions are `div[role=button]`, while the panel overlays content on both templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a semantic dialog/popover where modal behaviour is intended and native buttons for actions, with focus and dismissal managed by the platform.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are incomplete
findings.evidence: The rendered DOM had no canonical link, `/sitemap.xml` returned 404, and raw HTML lacked the visible H1; raw/rendered content-word coverage was 36%.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-referencing canonical, publish or explicitly reference an accurate sitemap, and server-render the primary heading/content.

findings.summary: The homepage is ineligible for back/forward cache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported three bfcache blockers, including Cache-Control:no-store on the main resource and a no-store JavaScript response.
findings.suggestedFix: Limit no-store to genuinely sensitive responses and retest bfcache eligibility after cookie/state handling changes.

findings.summary: Most transferred bytes come from third-party origins
findings.evidence: HAR measured 387,242 transferred bytes, of which 296,026 bytes (76%) and 18 of 30 requests were third-party; the simple homepage has no `` content.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, remove non-essential monitoring before consent, and defer analytics work.

findings.summary: The public search task has no structured agent capability and blocks automation
findings.evidence: The page probe found no WebMCP capability, Lighthouse agentic-browsing scored 0.5, and the representative search URL redirected to an anti-bot challenge.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose narrowly scoped, consent-aware agent tools or documented machine-readable search capabilities with explicit confirmation for consequential actions.

findings.summary: The installable manifest has no service-worker-backed offline behaviour
findings.evidence: The manifest declares display:standalone and a start_url, but the page probe found no controlling service worker.
findings.suggestedFix: Either provide a small offline fallback/service worker for the installable experience or avoid implying installability where offline startup cannot be supported.

findings.summary: Consent targets are short and the page does not reflow at mobile width
findings.evidence: DOM measurements show consent actions are 32px high, and the 360px screenshots are scaled desktop layouts because the viewport meta tag is absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Use at least 44px touch targets with adequate spacing and restore true narrow-width reflow with a viewport declaration.
